{{Infobox auto|type=Consumable item|renewable=Yes}}
An '''amnestic''' is an item that makes a [[villager]] forget its profession. Its tooltip reads "Causes a villager to forget who they are". It exists so that villagers can pick up new trades when an update of the pack changes them.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Villager Amnestics reset villager trades, so they can change update-to-update when needed. If you already have a weaponsmith, pop him a little forget-me-not to unlock the new trades.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is unlocked by picking up [[Estus Ash|Estus ash]] (glowstone dust).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/estus_ash.json}}</ref> Amnestics stack to 64.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/amnestic.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
An Amnestic is used on a villager: right-click the villager while holding it. The nearest villager to the player's aim point, about 1.5 blocks in front of the eyes, is then:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/amnestic/villager.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/give_villager.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/villager_consumed.mcfunction}}</ref>
* made to play a villager sound;
* set to no profession and level 1 (Novice), which removes its trades, with its restock timer reset and its experience set to 0;
* stripped of its [[favorite food]] flag, so it is given a new favorite food.
One Amnestic is used up, unless the player is in Creative mode.

The villager is chosen by distance alone, with no range limit, so the player should stand right next to the intended villager. The villager becomes unemployed and can take any profession from a nearby job site block, starting at Novice with the current trade lists.

An Amnestic can also be eaten. Eating one takes 1.6 seconds and removes every recipe the player has unlocked, and revokes the recipe advancements, so the recipe book starts empty again and recipes unlock afresh as items are picked up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/amnestic/player.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/player_consumed.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
The Amnestic is a consumable item (based on a poisonous potato) with a custom model. It no longer places an armor stand or acts as a spawn egg, so it has nothing to do with [[spawner]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/amnestic.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The recipe uses an azure bluet, and the 1.10 release notes call the item "a little forget-me-not".
* The item's model is named <code>amnestic_wrapped</code>.
